summary.zh-CN: 早期个别目标的亮点没有升级为同折对照中的稳定模型优势。

label.en-US: October 14 retained forecast review, change pilot and return correction
label.zh-CN: 10 月 14 日预测复核、变化实验与回撤修正

title.en-US: Find persistence and an early growth signal
title.zh-CN: 识别持续性与早期增长亮点

question.zh-CN: 哪些财务目标较可预测？

finding.en-US: ROA and gross margin were persistent. Net-profit-growth Rank IC was 0.134 for XGBoost versus -0.065 for persistence in one panel.
finding.zh-CN: ROA、毛利率有持续性；一个面板中净利润增速 Rank IC 为 XGBoost 0.134、persistence -0.065。

decision.en-US: Retain the positive observation, but do not compare it directly with a different panel or treat it as stock-return alpha.
decision.zh-CN: 保留正向观察，但不与不同面板直接比较，也不视为股票收益 Alpha。

title.en-US: Correct the baseline and compare common folds
title.zh-CN: 修正基线并比较共同折

question.en-US: Do ranking objectives outperform current-state persistence?
question.zh-CN: 排序目标是否超过当期状态持续性基线？

finding.en-US: An invalid initial run let persistence read future labels. The corrected 30-cell comparison removes it and persistence leads ROA and gross margin at all horizons.
finding.zh-CN: 最初无效运行让 persistence 读取未来标签；修正后的 30 单元对照剔除该结果，ROA、毛利率各期限均由 persistence 领先。

decision.en-US: Use only the corrected results; keep numeric, pairwise and listwise objectives under the same folds.
decision.zh-CN: 仅使用修正结果，数值、成对与列表目标保持同折。

title.en-US: Separate forecast accuracy from stock selection
title.zh-CN: 分开预测准确度与选股

question.zh-CN: 目标可预测性是否改善组合？

finding.en-US: Common-date portfolio bridges and longer-horizon growth/cash-conversion diagnostics remain unstable.
finding.zh-CN: 共同日期组合桥接及长期增长、现金转化诊断仍不稳定。

decision.en-US: Continue simple operating-state research; no model or portfolio promotion.
decision.zh-CN: 继续简单经营状态研究，不提升模型或组合资格。

title.en-US: Recompute stability and test changes separately
title.zh-CN: 重新核算稳定性，单独检验财务变化

question.en-US: Are average gains stable, and do changes add useful forecast information?
question.zh-CN: 平均改善能保持多久，预测变化能增加多少信息？

finding.en-US: All 12 corrected summary groups reconcile. The cash-flow 1Q ranking gain wins in 22/41 formations. Four matched change-target groups show no uniform direct-change advantage. Archived boundary drawdown omitted initial capital.
finding.zh-CN: 12 组修正后汇总全部核对一致。现金流一季度排序在 41 期赢了 22 期。四组变化预测没有显示直接预测变化的一致优势。原记录的期末回撤漏掉了初始资金。

decision.en-US: Retain the negative overall decision and the local lead; display corrected boundary drawdown, with no claim of qualified return increment.
decision.zh-CN: 保留整体未见稳定增量的判断和局部线索。展示修正后的期末回撤，收益增量仍待核实。

metric.zh-CN: 公司未来财务表现的排序相关

context.en-US: Corrected same-fold comparison, 1/2/4 quarters; reconstructed announcement-time inputs, not stock-return IC.
context.zh-CN: 修正后的相同训练期和测试期对照，1/2/4 季度。输入为公告时点重建，不是股票收益 IC。

interpretation.en-US: Persistence remains strongest; more complex objectives have no consistent increment.
interpretation.zh-CN: 沿用最新财报数值 始终最强，更复杂目标无一致增量。

label.zh-CN: XGB 比较公司两两高低

context.en-US: Same corrected 30-cell objective comparison; target-level persistence can be high without selection alpha.
context.zh-CN: 同一修正后的 30 单元目标对照。财务状态持续性高不代表选股 Alpha。

interpretation.en-US: The marginal forecast improvement is absent even where levels are very persistent.
interpretation.zh-CN: 即便财务水平持续性很高，也没有额外预测改善。

context.en-US: Separate same-fold corrected extension; 41/26/51 completed folds for 1/2/4 quarters. Target forecasts, not stock-return predictions.
context.zh-CN: 单独的修正相同训练期和测试期扩展。1/2/4 季度完成 41/26/51 个折。预测财务目标，不是股票收益。

interpretation.en-US: Growth persistence weakens by four quarters; no learned objective consistently beats it.
interpretation.zh-CN: 增长持续性到四季度显著减弱，学习目标没有一致超过它。

title.zh-CN: 现金转化预测期限对照

context.en-US: Separate same-fold corrected extension; 41/26/51 completed folds for 1/2/4 quarters. Target forecasts, not stock-return predictions.
context.zh-CN: 单独的修正相同训练期和测试期扩展。1/2/4 季度完成 41/26/51 个折。预测财务目标，不是股票收益。

interpretation.en-US: Pairwise leads at one quarter only; accounting extremes and varying horizons prevent a stable model conclusion.
interpretation.zh-CN: 成对目标仅在一季度领先；会计极值与不同期限表现阻止稳定模型结论。

label.zh-CN: XGB 比较公司两两高低

next_question.en-US: Can forecast changes add selection value beyond current profitability and valuation on common dates?
next_question.zh-CN: 预测变化能否在共同日期上，相对当期盈利与估值增加选股价值？

before.en-US: An initial persistence result had an impossible Rank IC of 1.
before.zh-CN: 最初 persistence 结果出现不合理的 Rank IC=1。

trigger.en-US: The baseline incorrectly read future values; the run was corrected.
trigger.zh-CN: 基线错误读取未来值，运行随后修正。

after.en-US: Exclude the invalid run and use corrected current-state baselines only.
after.zh-CN: 排除无效运行，仅使用修正的当期状态基线。

before.en-US: One annual panel showed a positive net-profit-growth model increment.
before.zh-CN: 一个年度面板显示正向净利润增速模型增量。

trigger.en-US: Later common-fold objectives did not show a stable learned-model advantage.
trigger.zh-CN: 后续共同折目标对照没有显示稳定学习模型优势。

after.en-US: The early observation remains recorded without model or portfolio promotion.
after.zh-CN: 保留早期观察，不提升模型或组合资格。

paragraphs.en-US: We reread the corrected saved forecasts and their run receipts. Most models added little beyond carrying the latest financial value forward. ROA and gross margin were persistent; revenue-growth ordering weakened at longer horizons.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 这次重新核对了修正后的预测输出和运行记录。多数模型没有比沿用最新财报数值多提供多少信息。ROA 和毛利率较容易保持原来的高低顺序，营收增速预测到更远的期限时，排序能力明显变弱。

paragraphs.en-US: The one-quarter cash-flow ranking is worth retaining as a narrow lead. Pairwise XGB improved average financial Rank IC by 0.050, but won in only 22 of 41 test formations and lost at the other two horizons. A positive average does not establish consistent performance in each period.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 经营现金流的一季度排序有一个值得保留的结果。两两比较模型的平均排序相关高出 0.050，但 41 个测试期只赢了 22 个，在另外两个期限也落后。平均分的改善与每期都能保持优势，是两件不同的事。

paragraphs.en-US: A new change-target pilot found that directly forecasting changes did not consistently beat forecasting levels. Seasonal controls mattered for ROA. Archived portfolio returns can be reconstructed, but neither this pilot nor those paths establish an investment gain from added forecasts.
paragraphs.zh-CN: 新跑的变化预测实验中，直接预测变化没有稳定胜过先预测水平再计算变化。ROA 的比较还受到财报季节性影响。历史组合的收益路径已经重新核算，预测信息能否持续改善选股收益，仍需要同条件的对照实验。
